methodology: All values are raw USD integers directly copied from SEC Company Facts, not millions or thousands. Filed statement tables have a thousands display scale; the USD values were verified against SEC extracted XBRL facts with decimals=-3.

The quarterly view selects Apr 1–Jun 30 single-quarter duration facts, not Jan 1–Jun 30 six-month/YTD facts. Balance-sheet facts are instants on Jun 30 of each comparison year, not annual-prior comparisons.
The annual view selects Jan 1–Dec 31 full-year duration facts, with Dec 31 balance-sheet instants.

For each metric and exact period, eligible consolidated USD facts on Forms 10-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q or 10-Q/A filed by the as-of date are ordered by filed date then accession. The latest compatible fact is selected. Exact source observations including fy/fp/frame are retained; fy/fp describe the filing and are not used to infer the fact period.

This latest-fact policy uses Q2 2026 comparative income for Q2 2025, Q2 2025 filings for Jun 30 2025 balances, FY2025 10-K income for both annual years, Q2 2026 comparative balances for Dec 31 2025, and FY2025 10-K comparative balances for Dec 31 2024.

All selected Dec 31 2025 balance-sheet facts additionally match the FY2025 annual report exactly. No relevant amended 10-K/10-Q appears in SEC submissions, and no conflicting values occur among Company Facts observations for these eight metrics and exact selected periods. This is not a blanket assertion that the issuer has never restated other periods or concepts.

Every selected observation was independently matched to the same accession’s official extracted XBRL: issuer CIK 0001682149, exact duration/instant, USD unit, no segment/scenario, same concept and value. Rounded narrative duplicates at lower precision were excluded from verification.
Cash means precisely us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue. No restricted-cash-inclusive concept, investments, Bitcoin or other crypto assets are substituted.
Net income/loss uses us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss, labeled net loss in these financial statements; it does not substitute loss attributable to common stockholders after preferred dividends.
Revenue uses us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax. us-gaap:Revenues independently agrees for all four selected duration periods.

Values are reported consolidated amounts, not pro forma or acquisition-adjusted results. Missing or ambiguous eligible observations must be null, never zero or estimated. No values are missing in these two views.
Latest quarter means latest completed quarter with an available SEC 10-Q, not the newest calendar quarter merely ended. The latest available 10-Q report period in submissions is 2026-06-30.

Only Apple Inc., CIK 0000320193, verified against the SEC submissions ticker mapping, is used. All values are raw USD from the official SEC Company Facts JSON, with independent matching against official filing Inline XBRL.

Income metrics use exact three-month (91-day) quarterly durations or 364-day annual durations. Year-to-date nine-month facts are excluded; quarter values are reported directly, not derived by subtraction.

Balance-sheet metrics are point-in-time instants, at each corresponding quarter or annual end. Quarterly prior-year balances come from the Q3 FY2025 10-Q, not the prior fiscal year-end balance column in the FY2026 10-Q.

Choose the latest compatible 10-K, 10-Q or amended filing observation on or before the as-of date for the exact concept, USD unit, start and end. Repeated prior-period facts use the later filing. A later comparative is not automatically evidence of a restatement.

FY2025 annual balances use the FY2026 Q3 filing as the latest compatible source; FY2025 annual income and FY2024 comparatives use FY2025 Form 10-K. Q3 FY2025 income uses the FY2026 Q3 filing; Q3 FY2025 balances use the FY2025 Q3 filing.

No differing values were found across compatible observations for these 32 selected period/metric cells. No 10-K/A or 10-Q/A for these target periods was present in the downloaded recent submissions list. This is a bounded check, not a blanket assurance about every historical restatement.

Company Facts fy and fp describe the filing reporting context, and frame uses calendar alignment; these are preserved in rawFact but are not used as the fiscal period labels. Exact filing durations establish the fiscal labels.

Cash is exclusively us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue; it excludes marketable securities and broader cash-plus-restricted-cash concepts. Total liabilities is us-gaap:Liabilities, not debt or liabilities-and-equity.
Missing or unverified metric-period values are null. No value interpolation, zero-filling or substitution from other companies is performed.

This is a captured snapshot as of the observed fetch time, not a live API connection. Latest means latest available reported period in the downloaded SEC submissions and facts, not every elapsed calendar/fiscal period.
